## findings

1. **SOURCE-POLICY RED — undeclared override of the resubmission amount (P-1, task 1 consequence).** Base event-field clause "equals the denied amount being resubmitted" gives W1 = 186.00 (9f591fcc) and W3 = 79.00 (bd374939); the extended policies give 337.00 and 68.50. Root cause: the `overwrite` blocks of coverage_ext_coordination_correction (lines 2617-2620) and coverage_ext_retro_authorization_correction (2187-2190) name only the policy sentence, not the event-field sentence (line 557). Affected: GT steps 11 and 15, `rebill_amount`. Previous revision: none.
2. **SOURCE-POLICY RED — base CO-22 gate displaced without declaration (P-2).** Symptom: base "coordination_of_benefits_update (CO-22, only after the coverage's coordination order has been updated following the denial; ...)" and "CO-22 (other coverage primary) is cured by a corrected claim after the coordination order is updated" vs extended "answers the claim's most recent other-coverage denial once the coordination on file is current". Evidence: coverages.927e3e01 coordination_order primary with no update trail after the 2026-06-18 denial; no task or share tool records a coverage details update; overwrite at lines 2617-2620 names only the amount sentence. Demonstrated consequence: base reading -> W1 refused -> the first-plan member appeal's contested charges are never fixed -> W2 and W4 cannot be recorded -> only a handoff remains; extended reading -> GT 337.00 / 38.48 / 68.50 / 127.20. Affected: coverage_ext_coordination_correction rule/overwrite; GT steps 11, 13, 17. Previous revision: none.
3. **SOURCE-TASK RED — W3's base eligibility rests on an unrecorded fact (T-1).** Inherited base sentence: "for CO-197 a retroactive authorization requested by the provider within prior_auth_retro_request_days of the date of service is filed as a corrected claim instead" (Medicaid 14 days; DOS 2026-05-19). No reachable record carries the request date (orders.8872e57e: prior_auth_status approved, prior_auth_number LSC-RA-55120931, hold_placed_date 2026-05-20, hold_reason none); the persona defers to the records. Second reading: the timely request is not shown -> "CO-197 (when no retroactive authorization is available) are appealed rather than corrected" -> no W3; the plan appeal then either stays blocked by its own sentence "not fixed until each authorization denial on the claim carries a corrected claim" (no solution) or, if the CO-197 is carried into the appeal, records 167.74 instead of 127.20. GT's proof asserts the hold was "for it", which no record states. Affected: seed (orders.8872e57e lacks the request evidence), GT step 15 and step 17. Previous revision: none.
4. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — relief factor rests on an award its own charter would not grant (T-2).** assistance_cases.577c9f48: Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment, fpl_percent 115.0, income 18,400, discount_granted_total 0. products/assistance.yaml: Full Discount applies at fpl <= 200 (discount_pct 100) and "the tier giving the larger total discount on the covered invoices applies"; the hardship tier requires window responsibility above 10% of income (1,840) while the only pre-application invoice (2437acf0, DOS 2026-01-13) carries 85.00. Consequence: on charter-consistent rows the relief is 100%, the contested exposure 0 and the amount in dispute 0.00 instead of 38.48 (the hardship tier the gold reads would not exist). Affected: seed initial_state.assistance_cases.577c9f48; GT step 13 (`amount_in_dispute`), computations[1].factor_sensitivity[first_plan_relief]. Previous revision: none.
5. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — unreal ladders (F-1, task 1 consequence).** first_plan_leftover: fall-through 0 (= baseline) unreachable for an Out-of-Network customer (clinical_lab_patient_cost_share true), so 64.14 is a fall-back no reader of such a plan would compute; first_plan_balance_share: "the payer class lets the laboratory bill the member a balance" true of every Out-of-Network customer; plan_appeal_valuation: "the payer class writes billed charges down" true of every Medicaid customer.
